notes.title: Progress Update (May 2022)
notes.notes:

[h1]Publishing[/h1]
A fairly new but promising publisher reached out to us and we had to scramble together a pitch deck and an evaluation build within 2 weeks. It didn't end up working out as they ended up deciding they only want singleplayer games for now.

We're not too disappointed about it as the process ended up making us pivot from wanting to self-publish to actively trying to find a good publisher that would provide us with additional funding as well. Once we have a much better evaluation build, we will start reaching out to more established publishers that have experience in releasing similar games like ours.

[h1]Internal Testing[/h1]
We have done several internal testing so far. The game looks really promising. One issue we have found out is that new-ish players do not actively discuss or plot to save themselves. Instead, during Eliminations they just go around the map exploring for items and activities. This seems to be because there isn't much rationale yet to determine why a specific player must be eliminated other than performance on Group Challenges. We will soon introduce more layered features in the game to give players a variety of reasons why they would prefer to keep certain players, and why they should actively plot to eliminate others. Once these are in the game, that would be a good evaluation build to start sending to publishers.
